lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Distinct high-luminance circular clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a coordinate grid across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of blobs, creating a mesh-like pattern across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity highlights to lower-intensity shadows along the ventral edge of each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced network of caustic light patterns (surface refraction) overlaying the primary pigmentation; five distinct vertical gill slits visible on the anterior portion of the visible flank.
